texts.text: Form in which to furnish particulars in respect of recruitment and employment of migrant
workman/workmen as prescribed under Rule 21, to the authorities specified under the explanation
below sub-section (2)  of Section 12 of Inter-State Migrant Workmen (Regulation of Employment and
Name and Address of the Contractor
Name and address of the sub-Contractor through -
Name and address of the establishment
Name and address of the Principal Employer
Name of the State in which the place of work is -
Name of the State in which recruitment was made
Permanent Home Address (Documentary proof of Certificate from competent local authority to be attached i.e.
Deputy Commissioner/Additional District Magistrate/Superintendent of Police
Whether the workman is a citizen of India within the meaning of Article 5 of the Constitution of India. If yes,
attach documentary proof (EPIC/Birth Certificate/Ration Card from the State of origin)
Whether the workman at any time was convicted in connection with a criminal case.
Whether any criminal case is pending against the workman at the time of making application.
If answer to (D) and (E) if negative a certificate obtained from a competent authority is to be attached.
Name of members of his family accompanying the workman
Name and address of the next of kin of the migrant workman
Place and address of residence in the Home State
Amount of outward journey allowance paid
Amount of wages for outward journey period paid
Nature of job required to be performed
Details of rates of wages and other allowances payable
Signature of the Contractor or his authorised representative
(Specified authority in the State in which migrant workman/workmen is/are employed)
(Specified authority in the State from which the migrant workman/workmen has/have been recruited)
the Contractor or his authorised representative
In case where migrant workmen concerned have been recruited from more than one State, separate returns shall be submitted in respect of the each such State.
